hed: Google opens Dreambeans AI app to all U.S. users 18 and older
dek: Google’s Dreambeans AI app is rolling out to every U.S. account 18+, The Verge reported Thursday, after a June test. The Android and iOS app pulls from Search, Gmail, Photos, Calendar, and Gemini to surface shopping tips, travel ideas, and event reminders paired with storybook-style drawings of the user. Google positioned the launch as a consumer companion layered on existing Google apps rather than a workplace agent.

cl.body: The Verge and consumer-tech desks highlight the uncanny storybook self-portraits and the breadth of Gmail/Photos access — useful daily nudges that also reopen familiar privacy questions about how much personal data an always-on AI companion should see.

cr.body: Google-friendly product coverage frames Dreambeans as an opt-in U.S. consumer rollout that turns existing Search, Calendar, and Gemini signals into proactive suggestions — a mainstream AI companion competing with Apple’s Siri AI push the same week.
